title: Asymptotics of the quantum invariants for surgeries on the figure 8 knot
container-title: Journal of Knot Theory and Its Ramifications
note: Rigorous asymptotic analysis of quantum invariants associated with the figure-eight knot; together with Ohtsuki's saddle-point/Borel-resummation analysis it supplies the literature backing for the figure-eight case of the Kashaev volume conjecture carried by the class \texttt{VolumeConjecture41} (whose instance is, since 2026-07-26, machine-proved sorry-free in-repo by an elementary Riemann-sum squeeze).PDF library/arxiv-math-0506456v1/ — joined 2026-08-16. The library copy was unlinked because its extracted title was the World Scientific masthead; OCR recovered the real title, which matched this entry. A batch-7 entry drafted from that OCR (id andersen2005, first author only — the byline runs into the affiliations in the transcription) was dropped in favour of this one.
